purpose: Describe simultaneous actions or a contradiction with awareness.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Vます stem + つつ; Vます stem + つつも
I planned the trip while listening to music.
Knowing it was wrong, I kept putting off the reply.
Although feeling anxious, I took the first step.
formation: Vます stem + つつ; Vます stem + つつも
restrictions: Simultaneous actions normally share a subject; つつも often concedes knowingly contrary behavior.
mistake: Use つつある for ongoing change, a different construction.
